struct ExpressionNode
    kind::Symbol
    text::String
    value::Int
    children::Vector{ExpressionNode}
end
ExpressionNode(kind, text = "", value = 0, children = ExpressionNode[]) =
    ExpressionNode(kind, text, value, children)
const LEVELS=(("||",), ("&&",), ("==", "!=", "<", "<=", ">", ">="), ("+", "-"), ("*", "/", "%"))
mutable struct ExpressionReader
    tokens::Vector{String}
    position::Int
end
function expression(text)
    tokens=[
        String(m.match) for
        m in eachmatch(r"[0-9]+|[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*|\|\||&&|[=!<>]=|[-+*/%!()<>]", text)
    ]
    readexpression!(ExpressionReader(tokens, 1), 1)
end
exprpeek(r) = r.position<=length(r.tokens) ? r.tokens[r.position] : ""
function readtoken!(r::ExpressionReader)
    token=r.tokens[r.position]
    r.position+=1
    token
end
function readexpression!(r, level)
    level==6 && return readunary!(r)
    node=readexpression!(r, level+1)
    while exprpeek(r) in LEVELS[level]
        op=readtoken!(r)
        right=readexpression!(r, level+1)
        node=ExpressionNode(:binary, op, 0, [node, right])
    end
    node
end
function readunary!(r)
    token=readtoken!(r)
    token in ("!", "-") && return ExpressionNode(:unary, token, 0, [readunary!(r)])
    if token=="("
        node=readexpression!(r, 1)
        readtoken!(r)
        return node
    end
    isdigit(token[1]) && return ExpressionNode(:number, "", parse(Int, token))
    if token=="in"
        readtoken!(r)
        name=readtoken!(r)
        readtoken!(r)
        return ExpressionNode(:state, name)
    end
    ExpressionNode(token=="_data" ? :data : :variable, token)
end
struct Action
    kind::Symbol
    name::String
    delay::Int
    text::String
    expr::Union{Nothing,ExpressionNode}
end
function actions(text)
    result=Action[]
    isempty(text) && return result
    for item in split(text, "; ")
        parts=split(item, ' '; limit = 2)
        word=parts[1]
        rest=parts[2]
        if word=="raise"
            fields=split(rest, ' '; limit = 2)
            push!(
                result,
                Action(
                    :raise,
                    fields[1],
                    0,
                    "",
                    length(fields)==2 ? expression(fields[2]) : nothing,
                ),
            )
        elseif word=="send"
            fields=split(rest, ' '; limit = 3)
            push!(
                result,
                Action(
                    :send,
                    fields[1],
                    parse(Int, fields[2]),
                    "",
                    length(fields)==3 ? expression(fields[3]) : nothing,
                ),
            )
        elseif word=="cancel"
            push!(result, Action(:cancel, rest, 0, "", nothing))
        elseif word=="log"
            if startswith(rest, '"')
                closing=findnext('"', rest, 2)
                tail=closing<length(rest) ? rest[(closing+2):end] : ""
                push!(
                    result,
                    Action(
                        :log,
                        "",
                        0,
                        rest[2:(closing-1)],
                        isempty(tail) ? nothing : expression(tail),
                    ),
                )
            else
                push!(result, Action(:log, "", 0, "", expression(rest)))
            end
        else
            push!(result, Action(:assign, word, 0, "", expression(rest[3:end])))
        end
    end
    result
end
mutable struct ChartState
    name::String
    kind::String
    parent::Int
    depth::Int
    children::Vector{Int}
    initialname::String
    defaultname::String
    deep::Bool
    entries::Vector{Vector{Action}}
    exits::Vector{Vector{Action}}
    transitions::Vector{Int}
end
ChartState(name, kind, parent, depth, initial = "", default = "", deep = false) = ChartState(
    name,
    kind,
    parent,
    depth,
    Int[],
    initial,
    default,
    deep,
    Vector{Action}[],
    Vector{Action}[],
    Int[],
)
struct Transition
    source::Int
    kind::String
    descriptors::Vector{String}
    delay::Int
    guard::Union{Nothing,ExpressionNode}
    target::Int
    localtarget::Bool
    actions::Vector{Action}
end
struct Chart
    states::Vector{ChartState}
    names::Dict{String,Int}
    variables::Dict{String,Int}
    transitions::Vector{Transition}
    order::Vector{Int}
end
childstates(c, s) = [x for x in c.states[s].children if c.states[x].kind!="history"]
compound(c, s) = s==1 || (c.states[s].kind=="state" && !isempty(childstates(c, s)))
parallelstate(c, s) = c.states[s].kind=="parallel" && !isempty(childstates(c, s))
atomic(c, s) = c.states[s].kind!="history" && isempty(childstates(c, s))
function descendant(c, s, parent)
    s=c.states[s].parent
    while s!=0
        s==parent && return true
        s=c.states[s].parent
    end
    false
end
initial(c, s) =
    isempty(c.states[s].initialname) ? childstates(c, s)[1] : c.names[c.states[s].initialname]
defaulttarget(c, s) =
    isempty(c.states[s].defaultname) ? initial(c, c.states[s].parent) :
    c.names[c.states[s].defaultname]
function checkexpression(c, node)
    node===nothing && return ""
    node.kind==:variable &&
        !haskey(c.variables, node.text) &&
        return "unknown variable $(node.text)"
    node.kind==:state && !haskey(c.names, node.text) && return "unknown state $(node.text)"
    for child in node.children
        error=checkexpression(c, child)
        !isempty(error) && return error
    end
    ""
end
function checkactions(c, list)
    for action in list
        action.kind==:assign &&
            !haskey(c.variables, action.name) &&
            return "unknown variable $(action.name)"
        error=checkexpression(c, action.expr)
        !isempty(error) && return error
    end
    ""
end
function buildchart(definitions)
    c=Chart(
        [ChartState("", "root", 0, 0)],
        Dict{String,Int}(),
        Dict{String,Int}(),
        Transition[],
        Int[],
    )
    errors=Dict{Int,String}()
    stateat=Dict{Int,Int}()
    for (line, text) in definitions
        fields=split(text, ' ')
        kind=fields[1]
        if kind in ("state", "parallel", "final", "history")
            name=fields[2]
            parentname=""
            init=""
            default=""
            deep=false
            if kind=="state"
                at=3
                if length(fields)>=3 && fields[3]!="initial"
                    parentname=fields[3]
                    at=4
                end
                at<=length(fields) && (init=fields[at+1])
            elseif kind=="parallel"
                length(fields)==3 && (parentname=fields[3])
            else
                parentname=fields[3]
                if kind=="history"
                    deep=fields[4]=="deep"
                    length(fields)==5 && (default=fields[5])
                end
            end
            if haskey(c.names, name)
                errors[line]="duplicate state $name"
            elseif !isempty(parentname) && !haskey(c.names, parentname)
                errors[line]="unknown state $parentname"
            elseif !isempty(parentname) &&
                   c.states[c.names[parentname]].kind in ("final", "history")
                errors[line]="$parentname cannot have children"
            else
                parent=isempty(parentname) ? 1 : c.names[parentname]
                index=length(c.states)+1
                push!(
                    c.states,
                    ChartState(name, kind, parent, c.states[parent].depth+1, init, default, deep),
                )
                c.names[name]=index
                push!(c.states[parent].children, index)
                stateat[line]=index
            end
        elseif kind=="var"
            name=fields[2]
            if haskey(c.variables, name)
                errors[line]="duplicate variable $name"
            else
                c.variables[name]=parse(Int, fields[3])
            end
        end
    end
    for (line, text) in definitions
        haskey(errors, line) && continue
        fields=split(text, ' ')
        kind=fields[1]
        error=""
        if kind in ("state", "final", "history")
            s=stateat[line]
            state=c.states[s]
            if kind=="state" && !isempty(state.initialname)
                child=state.initialname
                if !haskey(c.names, child)
                    error="unknown state $child"
                elseif c.states[c.names[child]].parent!=s ||
                       c.states[c.names[child]].kind=="history"
                    error="$child is not a child of $(state.name)"
                end
            elseif kind in ("final", "history")
                p=state.parent
                if c.states[p].kind!="state" || isempty(childstates(c, p))
                    error="$(state.name) needs a compound parent"
                elseif kind=="history" && !isempty(state.defaultname)
                    target=state.defaultname
                    if !haskey(c.names, target)
                        error="unknown state $target"
                    elseif !descendant(c, c.names[target], p) ||
                           c.states[c.names[target]].kind=="history"
                        error="$target is not a descendant of $(c.states[p].name)"
                    end
                end
            end
        elseif kind in ("entry", "exit")
            name=fields[2]
            if !haskey(c.names, name)
                error="unknown state $name"
            elseif c.states[c.names[name]].kind=="history"
                error="$name cannot have actions"
            else
                list=actions(split(text, " / "; limit = 2)[2])
                error=checkactions(c, list)
                if isempty(error)
                    push!(
                        kind=="entry" ? c.states[c.names[name]].entries :
                        c.states[c.names[name]].exits,
                        list,
                    )
                end
            end
        elseif kind=="on"
            matched=match(
                r"\Aon (\S+) (always|after ([0-9]+)|\S+)(?: \[(.*?)\])?(?: ([-~])> (\S+))?(?: / (.*))?\z",
                text,
            )
            name, trigger, delay, guard, arrow, target, body=matched.captures
            if !haskey(c.names, name)
                error="unknown state $name"
            elseif c.states[c.names[name]].kind in ("final", "history")
                error="$name cannot have transitions"
            else
                guardnode=guard===nothing ? nothing : expression(guard)
                list=body===nothing ? Action[] : actions(body)
                error=checkexpression(c, guardnode)
                isempty(error) &&
                    target!==nothing &&
                    !haskey(c.names, target) &&
                    (error="unknown state $target")
                isempty(error) && (error=checkactions(c, list))
                if isempty(error)
                    s=c.names[name]
                    typ=trigger=="always" ? "always" :
                        startswith(trigger, "after ") ? "timer" : "event"
                    push!(
                        c.transitions,
                        Transition(
                            s,
                            typ,
                            typ=="event" ? String.(split(trigger, '|')) : String[],
                            delay===nothing ? 0 : parse(Int, delay),
                            guardnode,
                            target===nothing ? 0 : c.names[target],
                            arrow=="~",
                            list,
                        ),
                    )
                    push!(c.states[s].transitions, length(c.transitions))
                end
            end
        end
        !isempty(error) && (errors[line]=error)
    end
    function visit(s)
        push!(c.order, s)
        for child in c.states[s].children
            visit(child)
        end
    end
    for s in c.states[1].children
        visit(s)
    end
    c, errors
end
struct ChartEvent
    name::String
    value::Int
end
struct Reservation
    due::Int
    number::Int
    transition::Int
    event::ChartEvent
end
mutable struct Engine
    chart::Chart
    config::Set{Int}
    variables::Dict{String,Int}
    data::Int
    queue::Vector{ChartEvent}
    reservations::Vector{Reservation}
    serial::Int
    histories::Dict{Int,Vector{Int}}
    clock::Int
    trace::Bool
    halted::Bool
    macros::Int
    micros::Int
    within::Int
    entered::Vector{Int}
    taken::Vector{Int}
    dwell::Vector{Int}
    entrytime::Vector{Int}
end
Engine(c) = Engine(
    c,
    Set{Int}(),
    copy(c.variables),
    0,
    ChartEvent[],
    Reservation[],
    0,
    Dict{Int,Vector{Int}}(),
    0,
    false,
    false,
    0,
    0,
    0,
    zeros(Int, length(c.states)),
    zeros(Int, length(c.states)),
    zeros(Int, length(c.states)),
    zeros(Int, length(c.states)),
)
struct EvaluationError <: Exception end
function evaluate(e, node)
    node.kind==:number && return node.value
    node.kind==:variable && return e.variables[node.text]
    node.kind==:data && return e.data
    node.kind==:state && return Int(e.chart.names[node.text] in e.config)
    if node.kind==:unary
        value=evaluate(e, node.children[1])
        return node.text=="!" ? Int(value==0) : -value
    end
    a=evaluate(e, node.children[1])
    op=node.text
    op=="&&" && a==0 && return 0
    op=="||" && a!=0 && return 1
    b=evaluate(e, node.children[2])
    op in ("&&", "||") && return Int(b!=0)
    if op in ("/", "%")
        b==0 && throw(EvaluationError())
        q=div(a, b)
        return op=="/" ? q : a-q*b
    end
    op=="+" && return a+b
    op=="-" && return a-b
    op=="*" && return a*b
    Int(op=="==" ? a==b : op=="!=" ? a!=b : op=="<" ? a<b : op=="<=" ? a<=b : op==">" ? a>b : a>=b)
end
function reserve!(e, delay, transition, event)
    e.serial+=1
    push!(e.reservations, Reservation(e.clock+delay, e.serial, transition, event))
end
function performactions!(e, list)
    try
        for action in list
            value=action.expr===nothing ? 0 : evaluate(e, action.expr)
            if action.kind==:assign
                e.variables[action.name]=value
            elseif action.kind==:raise
                push!(e.queue, ChartEvent(action.name, value))
            elseif action.kind==:send
                reserve!(e, action.delay, 0, ChartEvent(action.name, value))
            elseif action.kind==:cancel
                filter!(r->r.transition!=0 || r.event.name!=action.name, e.reservations)
            elseif action.kind==:log
                println(action.text, action.expr===nothing ? "" : string(value))
            end
        end
    catch error
        error isa EvaluationError || rethrow()
        push!(e.queue, ChartEvent("error.execution", 0))
    end
end
function closedentries(c, seeds)
    entering=Set(seeds)
    changed=true
    while changed
        changed=false
        for s in c.order
            s in entering || continue
            children=childstates(c, s)
            extra=parallelstate(c, s) ? children :
                  compound(c, s) && all(x->!(x in entering), children) ? [initial(c, s)] : Int[]
            for child in extra
                if !(child in entering)
                    push!(entering, child)
                    changed=true
                end
            end
        end
    end
    entering
end
function complete(e, s)
    c=e.chart
    compound(c, s) && return any(x->c.states[x].kind=="final" && x in e.config, childstates(c, s))
    parallelstate(c, s) && return all(x->complete(e, x), childstates(c, s))
    false
end
function enterstates!(e, entering)
    c=e.chart
    for s in c.order
        s in entering || continue
        state=c.states[s]
        push!(e.config, s)
        e.entered[s]+=1
        e.entrytime[s]=e.clock
        for t in state.transitions
            tr=c.transitions[t]
            tr.kind=="timer" && reserve!(e, tr.delay, t, ChartEvent("", 0))
        end
        for list in state.entries
            performactions!(e, list)
        end
        if state.kind=="final"
            p=state.parent
            push!(e.queue, ChartEvent("done.state.$(c.states[p].name)", 0))
            g=c.states[p].parent
            g!=0 &&
                parallelstate(c, g) &&
                all(x->complete(e, x), childstates(c, g)) &&
                push!(e.queue, ChartEvent("done.state.$(c.states[g].name)", 0))
        end
    end
end
effective(e, tr) =
    tr.target==0 ? Int[] :
    e.chart.states[tr.target].kind!="history" ? [tr.target] :
    get(e.histories, tr.target, [defaulttarget(e.chart, tr.target)])
function scope(e, tr)
    tr.target==0 && return 0
    c=e.chart
    targets=effective(e, tr)
    s=tr.source
    tr.localtarget && compound(c, s) && all(x->descendant(c, x, s), targets) && return s
    s=c.states[s].parent
    while !(compound(c, s) && all(x->descendant(c, x, s), targets))
        s=c.states[s].parent
    end
    s
end
exitset(e, tr) =
    tr.target==0 ? Set{Int}() : Set(s for s in e.config if descendant(e.chart, s, scope(e, tr)))
function matches(tr, kind, event, timer, index)
    kind=="always" && return tr.kind=="always"
    kind=="timer" && return index==timer
    tr.kind=="event" &&
        any(d->d=="*" || d==event.name || startswith(event.name, d*"."), tr.descriptors)
end
function selecttransitions!(e, kind, event, timer = 0)
    c=e.chart
    candidates=Int[]
    for a in c.order
        a in e.config && atomic(c, a) || continue
        s=a
        found=0
        while s!=1 && found==0
            for t in c.states[s].transitions
                tr=c.transitions[t]
                matches(tr, kind, event, timer, t) || continue
                accepted=true
                try
                    accepted=tr.guard===nothing || evaluate(e, tr.guard)!=0
                catch error
                    error isa EvaluationError || rethrow()
                    push!(e.queue, ChartEvent("error.execution", 0))
                    accepted=false
                end
                if accepted
                    found=t
                    break
                end
            end
            s=c.states[s].parent
        end
        found!=0 && !(found in candidates) && push!(candidates, found)
    end
    kept=Int[]
    exiting=Set{Int}()
    for t in candidates
        exits=exitset(e, c.transitions[t])
        if isempty(intersect(exiting, exits))
            push!(kept, t)
            union!(exiting, exits)
        end
    end
    kept
end
statenames(c, ids) = isempty(ids) ? "-" : join((c.states[s].name for s in ids), ',')
timername(c, t) = "after($(c.transitions[t].delay))@$(c.states[c.transitions[t].source].name)"
eventname(event) = event.value==0 ? event.name : "$(event.name)=$(event.value)"
function microstep!(e, selected, display)
    if e.within==1000
        println("LIVELOCK t=$(e.clock)")
        e.halted=true
        return
    end
    e.within+=1
    e.micros+=1
    c=e.chart
    scopes=[scope(e, c.transitions[t]) for t in selected]
    exiting=Set{Int}()
    for bound in scopes
        bound!=0 && union!(exiting, (s for s in e.config if descendant(c, s, bound)))
    end
    for s in c.order
        s in exiting || continue
        for h in c.states[s].children
            c.states[h].kind=="history" || continue
            e.histories[h]=[
                x for x in c.order if x in e.config &&
                    (c.states[h].deep ? atomic(c, x) && descendant(c, x, s) : c.states[x].parent==s)
            ]
        end
    end
    seeds=Int[]
    for (t, bound) in zip(selected, scopes)
        tr=c.transitions[t]
        tr.target==0 && continue
        for target in effective(e, tr)
            push!(seeds, target)
            s=c.states[target].parent
            while s!=bound
                push!(seeds, s)
                s=c.states[s].parent
            end
        end
    end
    entering=closedentries(c, seeds)
    e.trace && println(
        "[t=$(e.clock)] $display (",
        statenames(c, [c.transitions[t].source for t in selected]),
        "): exit ",
        statenames(c, [s for s in Iterators.reverse(c.order) if s in exiting]),
        "; enter ",
        statenames(c, [s for s in c.order if s in entering]),
    )
    for s in Iterators.reverse(c.order)
        s in exiting || continue
        for list in c.states[s].exits
            performactions!(e, list)
        end
        delete!(e.config, s)
        e.dwell[s]+=e.clock-e.entrytime[s]
        filter!(r->r.transition==0 || c.transitions[r.transition].source!=s, e.reservations)
    end
    for t in selected
        tr=c.transitions[t]
        performactions!(e, tr.actions)
        e.taken[tr.source]+=1
    end
    enterstates!(e, entering)
end
function macrostep!(e, kind, event = ChartEvent("", 0), timer = 0)
    e.macros+=1
    e.within=0
    e.data=event.value
    if kind=="start"
        enterstates!(e, closedentries(e.chart, [initial(e.chart, 1)]))
    else
        selected=selecttransitions!(e, kind, event, timer)
        !isempty(selected) &&
            microstep!(e, selected, kind=="timer" ? timername(e.chart, timer) : eventname(event))
    end
    while !e.halted
        e.data=0
        selected=selecttransitions!(e, "always", ChartEvent("", 0))
        if !isempty(selected)
            microstep!(e, selected, "always")
            continue
        end
        isempty(e.queue) && break
        queued=popfirst!(e.queue)
        e.data=queued.value
        selected=selecttransitions!(e, "event", queued)
        !isempty(selected) && microstep!(e, selected, eventname(queued))
    end
end
function warnings(c)
    reached=Set([initial(c, 1)])
    changed=true
    while changed
        before=length(reached)
        for s in c.order
            s in reached || continue
            p=c.states[s].parent
            p!=1 && push!(reached, p)
            compound(c, s) && push!(reached, initial(c, s))
            parallelstate(c, s) && union!(reached, childstates(c, s))
            for t in c.states[s].transitions
                target=c.transitions[t].target
                target!=0 && push!(
                    reached,
                    c.states[target].kind=="history" ? defaulttarget(c, target) : target,
                )
            end
        end
        changed=before!=length(reached)
    end
    for s in c.order
        c.states[s].kind!="history" &&
            !(s in reached) &&
            println("warning: unreachable state $(c.states[s].name)")
    end
end
function dumpstate(e)
    c=e.chart
    println("dump t=$(e.clock)")
    for s in c.order
        s in e.config && println(repeat(" ", 2*c.states[s].depth), c.states[s].name)
    end
    for name in sort(collect(keys(e.variables)))
        println("  var $name = $(e.variables[name])")
    end
    for s in c.order
        haskey(e.histories, s) &&
            println("  history $(c.states[s].name) = ", statenames(c, e.histories[s]))
    end
    for r in sort(e.reservations; by = r->(r.due, r.number))
        println(
            r.transition==0 ? "  send $(r.due) $(r.event.name) $(r.event.value)" :
            "  timer $(r.due) $(timername(c,r.transition))",
        )
    end
end
function script!(e, text)
    fields=split(text, ' ')
    command=fields[1]
    if command=="event"
        macrostep!(e, "event", ChartEvent(fields[2], length(fields)==3 ? parse(Int, fields[3]) : 0))
    elseif command=="tick"
        finish=e.clock+parse(Int, fields[2])
        while !e.halted && !isempty(e.reservations)
            index=argmin([(r.due, r.number) for r in e.reservations])
            r=e.reservations[index]
            r.due>finish && break
            deleteat!(e.reservations, index)
            e.clock=r.due
            macrostep!(e, r.transition==0 ? "event" : "timer", r.event, r.transition)
        end
        !e.halted && (e.clock=finish)
    elseif command=="set"
        name=fields[2]
        if haskey(e.variables, name)
            e.variables[name]=parse(Int, fields[3])
        else
            println("error: unknown variable $name")
        end
    elseif command=="trace"
        e.trace=fields[2]=="on"
    elseif command=="dump"
        dumpstate(e)
    elseif command=="eval"
        text=text[6:end]
        node=expression(text)
        error=checkexpression(e.chart, node)
        if !isempty(error)
            println("error: $error")
        else
            e.data=0
            try
                value=evaluate(e, node)
                println("$text -> $value")
            catch error
                error isa EvaluationError || rethrow()
                println("error: division by zero")
            end
        end
    end
end
function runchart(name, definitions, scripts)
    println("chart $name")
    c, errors=buildchart(definitions)
    if !isempty(errors)
        for line in sort(collect(keys(errors)))
            println("error line $line: $(errors[line])")
        end
        return
    end
    warnings(c)
    e=Engine(c)
    macrostep!(e, "start")
    for text in scripts
        e.halted && break
        script!(e, text)
    end
    println("end t=$(e.clock) macrosteps=$(e.macros) microsteps=$(e.micros)")
    for s in c.order
        c.states[s].kind=="history" && continue
        total=e.dwell[s]+(s in e.config ? e.clock-e.entrytime[s] : 0)
        println("  $(c.states[s].name) entered=$(e.entered[s]) taken=$(e.taken[s]) time=$total")
    end
end
function main()
    lines=readlines()
    position=2
    for _ in 1:parse(Int, lines[1])
        name=lines[position][7:end]
        position+=1
        definitions=Tuple{Int,String}[]
        while lines[position]!="RUN"
            push!(definitions, (position, lines[position]))
            position+=1
        end
        position+=1
        scripts=String[]
        while lines[position]!="END"
            push!(scripts, lines[position])
            position+=1
        end
        position+=1
        runchart(name, definitions, scripts)
    end
end
main()
